description: What a PR gate's secret scans read (GATE-SPEED R1, D-092): `change` scans the PR's own commits (merge-base..head) and the files it changes or leaves untracked; `full` scans all of HEAD's history and the whole tree. gate-noite always scans full, and a change to .gitleaks.toml scans full, so the base's history is judged every night. `full` is the rollback.
